description: This Java class OrderListState manages the state of an order list in a web application, including pagination, order status, order type, and filters. It provides methods to persist state in user sessions, update state based on HTTP request parameters, and retrieve order data from the database accordingly.

classes.name: OrderListState
classes.description: A session-scoped class that maintains the order list filter, pagination, and status states. It provides methods to update, retrieve, and query order data based on current state.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's OrderListState from the HTTP session or creates a default one if none exists.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the order list state based on request parameters, handling pagination or status/type/filter changes.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of orders from the database matching current state filters, including status, type, and date.
